stopping_rule: Exactly two new isolated role responses per condition, eight total. Preserve failures/no-buy; no retries or replacement. Do not pool previous exploratory outputs.
analysis: Report all choices and per-cell counts; flag within-identical-prompt disagreement separately from between-order differences. No significance, causal order effect, elasticity or human calibration claim.
execution: Same available conversation-model family, separate contexts, medium reasoning; exact model SKU and sampling seeds unverified. Serial batches may differ; no randomization or population independence.
